extension.summary: Repository of small, hand-picked Kodi addon fixes
extension.description: Hosts addons that have been forked and patched for a specific CoreELEC/Aeon Nox 5 setup. Currently: CU LRC Lyrics (DC Version) - lyrics sync/scraper/OK-OSD fixes; DC Artist Artwork DL - rotating artist fanart background service; Aeon Nox 5 Skin Fixes - companion skin patches both of those need; and a network watchdog for boots where the LAN doesn't come up on its own. See the repository README for the full list, plus manual-install remote keymaps that aren't installable addons.
extension.news: 1.1.0: renamed repository from "xDereCx Kodi Fixes" to "DereC Kodi Fixes". 1.0.0: initial release, includes CU LRC Lyrics (DC Version).

extension.summary: CU LRC Lyrics, fork with OK/OSD, sync, and scraper reliability fixes
extension.description: Fork of CU LRC Lyrics 6.7.1 (original by Taxigps/ronie, https://gitlab.com/ronie/script.cu.lrclyrics/) with several fixes applied on top: (1) the OK button on the remote no longer gets swallowed by the lyrics dialog's stolen input focus, and pressing OK now shows the music OSD/menu, with the lyrics view automatically reopening afterwards instead of requiring a full navigation reset; (2) manual sync offset correction (up/down during timed lyrics) restored after that same focus change had silently broken it, opening a dedicated on-screen slider; left/right seeks the track (10s/30s/1min with rapid-repeat acceleration, like Kodi's video OSD) with its own transient progress-bar overlay showing position/elapsed/total time, and the lyric line now immediately follows any seek instead of catching up several seconds later; (3) plain (untimed) txt lyrics no longer get stuck showing only the first line forever; (4) several scraper reliability fixes - a crash in the lrclib.net scraper that could silently abort the entire remaining fallback chain, a Music163 false-positive that returned songwriter-credit-only text as if it were real lyrics, and duration-aware filtering so a title/artist match to a different edit (radio edit, remix, extended version) gets rejected instead of producing badly out-of-sync lyrics. Automatically disables the original script.cu.lrclyrics on startup if found installed and enabled, since the two conflict as lyrics service. Optional on-demand lyrics translation via DeepL (off by default, needs your own API key) is available from the context menu, shown in an on-screen panel whose skin patch (see script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix) has only been tested on Aeon Nox 5 - other skins will still get working lyrics, but the translation panel and topbar fix need that skin. A single "Interface & translation language" setting (English/Español/Deutsch/Slovenčina/Čeština) picks both this add-on's own menus/notifications and the default lyrics translation target - independent of Kodi's own system language. Translation prefers real human translations (LyricsTranslate.com, and for Slovak/Czech also KaraokeTexty.sk/.cz) over DeepL/Google/Lingva machine translation whenever one is found and lines up with the original; for a Slovak or Czech target with no human translation in that exact language, the nearest Czech<->Slovak translation is used instead, since the two languages are close enough to be a better stand-in than a machine translation. See this repository's README and the version history below for details.
extension.summary: CU LRC Lyrics, fork s opravami OK/OSD, synchronizace a spolehlivosti stahovačů
extension.description: Fork CU LRC Lyrics 6.7.1 (originál od Taxigps/ronie, https://gitlab.com/ronie/script.cu.lrclyrics/) s několika opravami navíc: (1) tlačítko OK na dálkovém ovladači už nepohltí ukradené zaměření dialogu s textem písně a stisknutí OK nyní zobrazí hudební OSD/menu, přičemž se zobrazení textu poté automaticky znovu otevře, místo aby vyžadovalo úplný reset navigace; (2) ruční korekce synchronizačního posunu (nahoru/dolů během časovaného textu) obnovena poté, co ji stejná změna zaměření tiše rozbila - nyní otevírá vlastní posuvník na obrazovce; doleva/doprava přetáčí skladbu (10 s/30 s/1 min se zrychlením při rychlém opakovaném stisku, podobně jako video OSD v Kodi) s vlastním dočasným překryvem s ukazatelem průběhu zobrazujícím pozici/uplynulý/celkový čas, a řádek textu nyní okamžitě následuje jakékoli přetočení místo dohánění o několik sekund později; (3) obyčejný (nečasovaný) TXT text už neuvízne navždy na zobrazení jen první řádky; (4) několik oprav spolehlivosti stahovačů - pád ve stahovači lrclib.net, který mohl tiše přerušit celý zbývající řetězec záložních zdrojů, falešně pozitivní výsledek Music163, který vracel pouze řádky s autorskými zásluhami jako by šlo o skutečný text, a filtrování podle délky skladby, takže shoda názvu/interpreta s jinou verzí (rádiová edice, remix, prodloužená verze) je odmítnuta místo toho, aby vznikl špatně synchronizovaný text. Při spuštění automaticky vypne původní script.cu.lrclyrics, pokud je nainstalovaný a povolený, protože oba doplňky si konkurují jako služba pro texty písní. Volitelný překlad textů na vyžádání přes DeepL (ve výchozím stavu vypnutý, vyžaduje vlastní API klíč) je dostupný z kontextové nabídky a zobrazuje se v panelu na obrazovce, jehož úprava skinu (viz script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix) byla testována pouze na Aeon Nox 5 - ostatní skiny budou mít funkční texty písní i tak, ale panel s překladem a oprava horní lišty vyžadují tento skin. Jedno nastavení "Jazyk rozhraní a překladu" (English/Español/Deutsch/Slovenčina/Čeština) určuje jak jazyk vlastních menu/oznámení doplňku, tak výchozí cílový jazyk překladu textů - nezávisle na systémovém jazyce Kodi. Překlad upřednostňuje skutečné lidské překlady (LyricsTranslate.com, a pro slovenštinu/češtinu i KaraokeTexty.sk/.cz) před strojovým překladem DeepL/Google/Lingva, kdykoli se nějaký najde a sedí s originálem; pokud pro slovenský nebo český cíl neexistuje lidský překlad přesně v tomto jazyce, použije se nejbližší česko-slovenský překlad místo toho, protože jsou si oba jazyky dost blízké na to, aby byly lepší náhradou než strojový překlad. Podrobnosti najdete v README tohoto repozitáře a v historii verzí níže.
extension.summary: CU LRC Lyrics, Fork mit Korrekturen für OK/OSD, Synchronisation und Quellenzuverlässigkeit
extension.description: Fork von CU LRC Lyrics 6.7.1 (Original von Taxigps/ronie, https://gitlab.com/ronie/script.cu.lrclyrics/) mit mehreren zusätzlichen Korrekturen: (1) die OK-Taste der Fernbedienung wird nicht mehr vom gestohlenen Eingabefokus des Songtext-Dialogs verschluckt, und ein Druck auf OK zeigt nun das Musik-OSD/Menü an, wobei die Songtextansicht danach automatisch wieder geöffnet wird, statt einen kompletten Navigations-Reset zu erfordern; (2) manuelle Synchronisationskorrektur (Hoch/Runter während zeitgesteuerter Songtexte) wiederhergestellt, nachdem dieselbe Fokusänderung sie stillschweigend kaputt gemacht hatte - öffnet jetzt einen eigenen Schieberegler auf dem Bildschirm; Links/Rechts spult den Titel (10 s/30 s/1 min mit Beschleunigung bei schnell wiederholtem Drücken, wie beim Video-OSD von Kodi) mit einer eigenen kurzzeitigen Fortschrittsbalken-Einblendung, die Position/verstrichene/Gesamtzeit anzeigt, und die Songtextzeile folgt jetzt sofort jedem Spulen, statt erst nach mehreren Sekunden aufzuholen; (3) einfache (nicht zeitgesteuerte) TXT-Songtexte bleiben nicht mehr für immer bei der ersten Zeile hängen; (4) mehrere Zuverlässigkeitskorrekturen bei den Quellen - ein Absturz im lrclib.net-Scraper, der die gesamte restliche Fallback-Kette stillschweigend abbrechen konnte, ein Music163-Fehlalarm, der reine Textdichter-/Komponisten-Credit-Zeilen als echten Songtext zurückgab, und eine längenbasierte Filterung, sodass eine Titel-/Interpreten-Übereinstimmung mit einer anderen Version (Radioedit, Remix, Extended Version) abgelehnt wird, statt schlecht synchronisierten Songtext zu erzeugen. Deaktiviert beim Start automatisch das ursprüngliche script.cu.lrclyrics, falls installiert und aktiviert, da beide als Songtext-Dienst in Konflikt stehen. Eine optionale Songtext-Übersetzung auf Abruf via DeepL (standardmäßig deaktiviert, benötigt einen eigenen API-Schlüssel) ist über das Kontextmenü verfügbar und wird in einem Bildschirmpanel angezeigt, dessen Skin-Patch (siehe script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix) nur mit Aeon Nox 5 getestet wurde - andere Skins erhalten trotzdem funktionierende Songtexte, aber das Übersetzungspanel und die Titelleisten-Korrektur benötigen diesen Skin. Eine einzige Einstellung "Oberflächen- und Übersetzungssprache" (English/Español/Deutsch/Slovenčina/Čeština) legt sowohl die Sprache der eigenen Menüs/Benachrichtigungen dieses Add-ons als auch die Standard-Zielsprache der Songtext-Übersetzung fest - unabhängig von der Systemsprache von Kodi. Die Übersetzung bevorzugt echte menschliche Übersetzungen (LyricsTranslate.com, für Slowakisch/Tschechisch zusätzlich KaraokeTexty.sk/.cz) gegenüber der maschinellen Übersetzung via DeepL/Google/Lingva, sobald eine gefunden wird und zum Original passt; gibt es für ein slowakisches oder tschechisches Ziel keine menschliche Übersetzung in genau dieser Sprache, wird stattdessen die jeweils andere (Tschechisch/Slowakisch) verwendet, da sich beide Sprachen nahe genug sind, um ein besserer Ersatz als eine maschinelle Übersetzung zu sein. Details siehe README dieses Repositorys und die Versionshistorie unten.
extension.summary: CU LRC Lyrics, fork con correcciones de OK/OSD, sincronización y fiabilidad de buscadores
extension.description: Fork de CU LRC Lyrics 6.7.1 (original de Taxigps/ronie, https://gitlab.com/ronie/script.cu.lrclyrics/) con varias correcciones añadidas: (1) el botón OK del mando ya no queda absorbido por el foco de entrada robado del diálogo de la letra, y al pulsar OK ahora se muestra el OSD/menú de música, reabriéndose después automáticamente la vista de la letra en lugar de requerir un reinicio completo de la navegación; (2) se restauró la corrección manual del desfase de sincronización (Arriba/Abajo durante letras sincronizadas) después de que ese mismo cambio de foco la rompiera silenciosamente, abriendo ahora un control deslizante propio en pantalla; Izquierda/Derecha avanza o retrocede la canción (10 s/30 s/1 min con aceleración al pulsar repetidamente, como el OSD de vídeo de Kodi) con su propia superposición temporal de barra de progreso que muestra posición/tiempo transcurrido/tiempo total, y la línea de la letra ahora sigue el avance o retroceso de inmediato en lugar de ponerse al día varios segundos después; (3) las letras TXT normales (sin sincronizar) ya no se quedan atascadas mostrando solo la primera línea para siempre; (4) varias correcciones de fiabilidad en los buscadores - un fallo en el buscador lrclib.net que podía interrumpir silenciosamente toda la cadena de alternativas restante, un falso positivo de Music163 que devolvía líneas de créditos de autoría como si fueran la letra real, y un filtrado según la duración para que una coincidencia de título/artista con una edición distinta (edición de radio, remix, versión extendida) se rechace en lugar de producir una letra mal sincronizada. Desactiva automáticamente el script.cu.lrclyrics original al iniciar si está instalado y activado, ya que ambos entran en conflicto como servicio de letras. La traducción de letras opcional bajo demanda mediante DeepL (desactivada por defecto, necesita tu propia clave de API) está disponible desde el menú contextual y se muestra en un panel en pantalla cuyo parche de skin (ver script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix) solo se ha probado con Aeon Nox 5 - otros skins seguirán teniendo letras funcionales, pero el panel de traducción y la corrección de la barra superior necesitan ese skin. Un único ajuste "Idioma de interfaz y traducción" (English/Español/Deutsch/Slovenčina/Čeština) elige tanto el idioma de los propios menús/notificaciones de este complemento como el idioma de destino predeterminado para la traducción de letras - independientemente del idioma del sistema de Kodi. La traducción prioriza traducciones humanas reales (LyricsTranslate.com, y para eslovaco/checo también KaraokeTexty.sk/.cz) sobre la traducción automática de DeepL/Google/Lingva siempre que se encuentre una y coincida con el original; si para un destino eslovaco o checo no existe una traducción humana en ese idioma exacto, se usa en su lugar la traducción checo-eslovaca más cercana, ya que ambos idiomas son lo bastante parecidos como para ser un mejor sustituto que una traducción automática. Consulta el README de este repositorio y el historial de versiones a continuación para más detalles.
extension.news:
1.23.3: swapped the per-line machine-filled marker from "† " to "» " per user preference. 1.23.2: hybrid results now mark each individual machine-filled line with a "† " prefix directly in the translation panel, not just as an aggregate percentage in the source strip - confirmed font_translation (NotoSans-Regular) actually has this glyph via its own cmap table before picking it; several tried symbols (gear/star/diamond/lightning, and an actual emoji) are missing from this font and would have rendered as empty boxes. 1.23.1: fixed a real bug found live - a hybrid result's DeepL gap-fill could land in the wrong language even with 1.22.1's cross-fallback fix, because that fix trusted the KaraokeTexty DOMAIN (.sk vs .cz) to know what language its own content is in, and that isn't reliable: confirmed live, karaoketexty.sk served an entirely Czech-language translation column for one song (verified via Czech-only vs Slovak-only diacritic characters - 30 cz-only, 0 sk-only - despite the .sk domain and no cross-fallback suffix on the source name), so the gap-fill correctly followed the addon's Slovak target language while the human-covered lines it was supplementing were actually Czech. human_translation_lang() now detects the ACTUAL fetched content's language via that same diacritic heuristic first, only falling back to the source-name suffix or target_lang when the text is too short/plain to tell (no distinguishing diacritics at all). 1.23.0: fixed a real bug found live - repeating the exact same track (repeat-one, or a short playlist looping back to it) did not restart CU LRC lyrics OR the translation panel at all. Root cause was two separate identity checks that only ever compare artist+title: myPlayerChanged() treated the repeat as "nothing changed" since Song.__eq__ doesn't know about actual playback restarting, so it never even re-fetched lyrics; and even after fixing that, a fresh GUI instance's reset_controls() also only compares an artist|title fingerprint to decide whether to preserve an already-showing translation (needed for the OK/OSD reopen of a still-playing song), which can't tell that apart from a genuine repeat either, and would leave the translation panel WIN properties claiming "shown" while the actual (new) list control was empty. onAVStarted now passes a force flag all the way through myPlayerChanged() and the GUI's kwargs (song_restarted) so a genuine new-playback-start event (Kodi fires onAVStarted again even for an exact repeat) always re-triggers both lyrics and translation, while the OK/OSD same-song reopen path (which doesn't go through onAVStarted) keeps its existing preserve-translation behavior. 1.22.2: fixed a real bug found live testing 1.22.1 - is_fully_human_source() used to treat a cached translation as fully human whenever the CURRENT hybrid marker ("[CR]+") was absent from its source string, but a cache file written under an EARLIER hybrid format (" + " and "(NN% / NN%)", before this session's 2-line "[CR]+" display was introduced) doesn't contain that marker either, so it read as "not hybrid" and got frozen as permanently trusted - confirmed live, a song's translation panel was stuck showing the raw old-format string ("KaraokeTexty + DeepL[CR](92% / 8%)") forever and never re-attempted the new bs4 version at all. is_fully_human_source() now checks the source name against an exact whitelist of the fixed fully-human names instead, which can't be fooled by a hybrid format change since it doesn't try to detect what a hybrid name looks like. 1.22.1: bumped the required beautifulsoup4/soupsieve versions to 4.15.0/2.9.2 (was 4.12.2/2.4.1, matching the box's previously-stuck version) to test whether a scraper-matching discrepancy seen live (a line confirmed identical after normalization both locally and via a fresh page re-fetch, yet still reported as a miss on the box) is actually a bs4-version-specific behavior difference. bs4 4.13+ added a hard runtime dependency on typing_extensions (bs4/_typing.py imports it unconditionally, not just under TYPE_CHECKING), so this also adds a new script.module.typing-extensions (4.16.0) vendored addon. 1.22.0: fixed a real language-mixing bug in the hybrid human+DeepL gap-fill (1.18.0) - the gap-fill DeepL call always translated into self.TRANSLATE_LANG (the requested target language), but a KaraokeTexty cross-fallback human result (source name suffixed "(CS)"/"(SK)") is actually in the OTHER of the two languages, so a Slovak target that fell back to the Czech site could end up with Czech human lines and Slovak DeepL-filled lines mixed in the same translation panel. New lib/humantranslate.py human_translation_lang() derives the gap-fill's target language from the actual human source used instead of always assuming target_lang. 1.21.1: fixed a real bug from 1.21.0 - the hybrid source string format changed to "Name (92%)[CR]+ DeepL (8%)" for the new 2-line display, which broke the "[CR]+"-based hybrid detection this update also had to fix in is_fully_human_source(), and the end-of-song credit's DeepL/percentage stripping (previously done by splitting the display string on " + ", which no longer appears literally in the new format). The credit name is now tracked in its own culrc.translation.credit_source property instead of being parsed back out of the display string at all. 1.21.0: the translation-panel source strip (script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml.dat, now a 2-line textbox instead of a single-line label) shows a hybrid "KaraokeTexty + DeepL" result as two lines - the source names, then the human/machine coverage percentage on its own line - instead of a single truncated line. 1.20.1: reworked the fuzzy last-resort tier from a character-level similarity percentage to a word-level diff count (still via difflib.SequenceMatcher, just fed word lists instead of raw strings) - a fixed percentage threshold penalizes short lines unfairly (a single wrong word in a 4-word line can drop the character-ratio to 70-80%, well under any reasonable threshold, while the same single-word difference barely dents a long line's ratio), whereas "at most one differing word" means the same thing regardless of line length, confirmed with both long and short synthetic test lines. Requires at least 3 words on both sides so a 1-2 word line can't trivially match almost anything. 1.20.0: added a fourth, absolute-last-resort matching tier using Python's standard difflib.SequenceMatcher for a line that's genuinely a near-miss - a wording variant between the two sources rather than a formatting difference. Every match now logs which of the four tiers found it. 1.19.1: a hybrid "KaraokeTexty + DeepL" result (see 1.18.0's gap-filling) is no longer cached forever - only a FULLY human match is, since a hybrid one might improve to a better ratio (or full human coverage) later, whether from a matching-logic improvement or the site's own content changing, and re-checking it on the next view is cheap. The end-of-song credit still shows for a cached hybrid result exactly as before, this only changes whether it's re-attempted. 1.19.0: added a third, last-resort content-matching tier for KaraokeTexty alignment - after exact single-line and merge-window matching both fail for a line, tries again with internal whitespace removed too (not just punctuation), catching a word split differently across a line-break or hyphenation quirk between the two sources. This tier is strictly more permissive than the other two (dropping word boundaries can in principle equate two genuinely different phrases), so it only ever runs after they've both already failed for that line, and every match now logs which of the three tiers found it. 1.18.3: the end-of-song translation credit no longer mentions DeepL for a hybrid "KaraokeTexty + DeepL" result - DeepL only filled in a few lines the human source didn't cover, it didn't do the actual translation, so the thank-you message now credits just the human site/translator. 1.18.2: apostrophes are now deleted entirely rather than treated as a word boundary when normalizing lines for comparison - two independently-transcribed sources commonly differ on whether a contraction keeps its apostrophe at all (e.g. "don't" vs "dont"), and unlike other punctuation it sits inside a word, so turning it into a space like the rest would wrongly split one word into two instead of unifying the spellings. 1.18.1: fixed a real bug in the line-merge logic - a "line" that's purely punctuation (e.g. a standalone ellipsis used as its own
-separated line to mark a pause/trail-off, where the original combines it into the surrounding line with a comma instead) normalizes to nothing and has no real content to align on, but keeping it as its own pairs entry broke the merge-window check, which stopped at the first empty entry instead of skipping past it - confirmed live on a real song. These punctuation-only "lines" are now dropped entirely when parsing each column, so real content lines stay adjacent and merge correctly across where they used to sit. 1.18.0: KaraokeTexty content alignment no longer requires 100% coverage to be used at all - a partial human match now keeps every line it did find (tagged e.g. "KaraokeTexty + DeepL") and machine-translates only the specific remaining gaps (e.g. a chorus the fan site never wrote out in the original language, so there was nothing to match against at all), instead of discarding the whole human result and falling back to pure machine translation for the entire song. 1.17.1: widened the line-merge window from 2-3 to 2-5 consecutive site lines when checking whether they combine to match one original line. 1.17.0: KaraokeTexty content alignment now also matches when a single original (timed) line corresponds to several consecutive lines on the fan site - e.g. our LRC has one line combining two short phrases with a comma, while the site writes each phrase as its own
-separated line (confirmed live on a real song, this was a real source of low match rates, not missing content). Exact single-line matches are still tried and applied first; only lines with no direct match fall through to checking 2-3-line merge windows. 1.16.0: once the last timed lyric line has passed, if a human translation source was used (LyricsTranslate/KaraokeTexty, never DeepL/Google/Lingva), shows a "translation by X, support them at Y" credit for ~25s - includes the individual credited translator's name when KaraokeTexty shows one. Fixed a real bug found while adding this: KaraokeTexty's translator-credit link is nested inside the same span as the last translated line with no
separating it, so it was silently glued onto the end of that line's text before this fix, corrupting its content-match against the original. Requires script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix 1.6.0+ for the new skin overlay. 1.15.2: addon description (all 4 translated languages) now mentions the human-translation-first behavior and the Czech<->Slovak cross-fallback, was undocumented before. 1.15.1: normalized punctuation/quote-style before comparing lines for KaraokeTexty content alignment (curly vs straight apostrophes, commas/periods, double spacing) - a single differing character was failing an otherwise-identical line's match, confirmed live (one song matched only 9/32 lines before this fix). 1.15.0: KaraokeTexty.sk/.cz human translations are now aligned by CONTENT instead of only by total line count - the scraper now keeps both the original-language and translated columns (not just the translation) and matches each of the addon's own original lyric lines against KaraokeTexty's original-language lines to find its translation, reusing the same translation for a repeated line (e.g. a chorus sung multiple times) even when the fan site only wrote it out once or twice. Falls back to machine translation only if any original line has no match at all (100% coverage required, no partial results). LyricsTranslate still uses the simpler exact-count check for now, since its original-language text isn't in the same page load. 1.14.4: vendored this addon's module dependencies (beautifulsoup4, chardet, mutagen, requests, and requests'/beautifulsoup4's own sub-dependencies soupsieve/urllib3/certifi/idna) as real addon packages in this repository instead of relying only on Kodi's official repo for them, and bumped the declared minimum versions to match what's actually shipped/tested (was pinned to matrix-era minimums from the original fork, e.g. beautifulsoup4 4.8.2 vs the 4.12.2 actually in use). 1.14.3: fixed a real bug in the KaraokeTexty.sk/.cz scraper - the old bs4 4.8.2 bundled with this Kodi build silently drops some lines when using col.find_all('br') + br.replace_with('\n') on this site's markup (confirmed: modern bs4 gets the full line count from the identical page, old bs4 loses some - reproduced the exact discrepancy directly against bs4==4.8.2). Replaced with a plain regex split on the column's raw inner HTML, which doesn't depend on that bs4 API and gets the correct count on both old and new bs4. 1.14.2: fixed a real bug in the human-translation line-count check for timed lyrics - self.pOverlay (and therefore the original-lines array) includes blank entries for bare timing markers with no lyric text, which a scraped human translation never has, so the comparison was checking against the wrong (too-high) count and would have misaligned every line after the first blank marker had it ever matched. Now compares against the non-empty line count and splices matching human lines back into their original non-empty positions, leaving blank timing-marker slots blank. 1.14.1: fixed a real bug in 1.14.0 - a pre-existing machine-translation cache file (e.g. from before this version) was trusted forever and never re-attempted, so a song already translated once via DeepL/Google/Lingva would never actually try the new human sources at all. Now only a cached HUMAN translation is trusted; any cached DeepL/Google/Lingva result is always re-attempted (human sources first) on the next view. 1.14.0: new lib/humantranslate.py adds human (non-machine) translation sources tried before DeepL/Google/Lingva - LyricsTranslate.com (all 5 addon languages, discovered via a DuckDuckGo site: search since LT's own search is behind an unsolvable Cloudflare challenge from a scripted request) and KaraokeTexty.sk/.cz (Slovak/Czech only, with a Slovak-Czech cross-fallback when only the other of the two exists, since the two languages are close enough to be a better stand-in than machine translation). For timed lyrics, a human translation is only used if its line count matches the original exactly (a human translator doesn't preserve line boundaries the way translating the exact same array does) - otherwise falls through to machine translation as before. For untimed lyrics any line count is fine. A cached human translation is never re-fetched or downgraded. 1.13.2: updated the one-time first-timed-lyrics tip notification (string #32012), which only ever mentioned Up/Down sync and was now stale since 1.10.0 added Left/Right seek - now mentions both. 1.13.1: widened the lyrics sync-offset slider range (context menu "Sync", or up/down on timed lyrics) from ±20s to ±30s. 1.13.0: skip translating lyrics into English when they're already in English (target language = English only) - a cheap stopword-frequency heuristic (lib/translate.py looks_like_english(), not a real language detector) avoids burning DeepL/Google/Lingva quota on a no-op translation, for both manual "Show translation" and "sticky" auto-translate on a new track. Only applied for an English target, since the same short-circuit for the other 4 languages would need a reliable stopword list per language to do safely without risking skipping a translation that was actually needed. 1.12.0: new unified "Interface & translation language" setting (English default, plus Español/Deutsch/Slovenčina/Čeština) - one choice now drives both this add-on's own menus/notifications/dialogs (via a new lib/localization.py that reads the matching resources/language/resource.language.xx_yy/strings.po directly, independent of Kodi's own system language) and the default lyrics translation target language, replacing the old separate free-text translate_lang setting (previously constrained to sk/cs only). Added full cs_CZ, es_ES and de_DE translations (sk_SK and en_GB already existed) plus matching addon.xml description/summary entries for Kodi's Add-ons browser (that part still follows Kodi's system language, a Kodi limitation - only this add-on's own runtime strings follow the new setting). 1.11.2: fixed a real bug - the highlighted lyric line did not reliably follow a seek (either left/right or clicking a line to jump to it). refresh() only ever reschedules its own timer for the NEXT line boundary, computed from the position BEFORE the seek, so the display kept following the pre-seek timeline until that stale timer happened to fire on its own, which could take several seconds and looked like lyrics not reacting to seeking at all. Both seek paths now force an immediate stop_refresh()+refresh() right after seekTime() instead of waiting on the stale timer. 1.11.1: bumped script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix requirement to 1.5.0 for the repositioned/widened seek overlay (no library code change). 1.11.0: left/right seek now shows a transient progress-bar overlay (position on the full track timeline, elapsed/total time, and the +/-10s/30s/1:00 amount just seeked) matching Kodi's own video seek OSD style, auto-hiding after ~1.5s of no further presses - since this dialog swallows the native seek OSD entirely, seeking previously gave no visual feedback at all about where it landed. Requires script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix 1.3.0+ for the new skin controls. 1.10.0: large batch of translation and sync fixes. Translation: added a direct Google Translate fallback tier (DeepL to Google to Lingva) since it's the same engine Lingva proxies but doesn't depend on a specific public instance's uptime; translation is now "sticky" for the rest of the session once turned on - a new song reuses its cache or fetches a fresh one automatically, same as pressing "Show translation" manually; a cached Google/Lingva result gets upgraded to DeepL automatically once a DeepL key is available again; the translation panel now fills in progressively as each line arrives instead of staying blank for 20-30s on the Google/Lingva per-line fallback (and this now also correctly finishes for DeepL's single batch call, which was a real bug - the panel used to get stuck showing the original untranslated text until a full reopen); context menu label now toggles between "Show translation" and "Hide translation" instead of always reading the same regardless of state; missing Slovak strings.po entries for the last few versions' new strings (was silently falling back to English) are filled in. Sync offset: fixed a real bug where the offset appeared to reset after the OK/OSD reopen or a next-track change - self.syncadjust is now the single source of truth (read directly from the lyrics file's own [offset:N] tag every time, instead of being split between that tag and a separately-tracked live delta that only one of two code paths knew about); the sync slider now runs in its own dedicated skin window (see script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix 1.2.0) instead of the shared DialogSlider.xml also used for volume/seek/brightness elsewhere in Kodi. Other: a fast local .lrc lookup could lose a race against the previous song's GUI thread still cleaning up, silently skipping showing lyrics (and therefore translation) entirely until a manual OK/OSD reopen forced a retry - now waits up to ~2s for that cleanup instead of giving up immediately; left/right on the remote now seeks the track (this dialog was swallowing all input, including the seek that normally works with no dialog open at all), with the same rapid-repeat acceleration as Kodi's video seek OSD (10s / 30s / 60s). 1.9.0: translation now falls back to a free Lingva Translate instance (no key needed, auto-detects source language) when no DeepL key is set, or when DeepL fails/runs out of its one-time character credit - previously it just showed an error in that case. The Lingva instance used is configurable in settings in case the default (lingva.ml) goes down. 1.8.0: added an optional, off-by-default lyrics translation feature (context menu "Show translation") using the DeepL API - requires an API key set in this addon's settings. On-demand only (never fetched automatically per song, to avoid burning API quota on tracks you don't care about), and the result is cached as a plain text file alongside the addon's own saved lyrics so it's only translated once per song. 1.7.0: now declares script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix as a real add-on dependency, so Kodi installs it automatically alongside this one instead of it being an easy-to-miss separate manual step - it still needs to be run once from Program add-ons to actually patch the skin (can't auto-patch a third-party skin without the user's OK). Also now auto-disables the original script.cu.lrclyrics on every Kodi startup if it's found installed and enabled, since the two can't both run as the lyrics service - previously this conflict had to be resolved manually. 1.6.0: up/down during timed lyrics now opens the same on-screen slider dialog used by the context menu's "Sync" option, instead of silently nudging a hidden offset and popping a "Sync offset: +0.5s" notification that didn't say which direction was which. The slider dialog has a static "LATER <---- SYNC OFFSET ----> EARLIER" legend plus a live readout ("Lyrics play Xs earlier/later"/"In sync"), auto-closes after 4s of no input, and the slider step matches the old 0.5s nudge. 1.5.2: clear the previous song's lyrics from the screen immediately on song change, instead of leaving the old lyrics visible for the few seconds get_lyrics() can take to run scraper lookups for the new song. 1.5.1: fixed the same native Kodi crash as 1.5.0 recurring, because 1.5.0 only excluded the ".offset(N)" + "MusicPlayer.Duration" combination while the next-song lyrics prefetch (Song.next(), added for the duration-aware filtering in 1.4.0) still queried Title/Artist/Lyrics/Property with ".offset(1)" - it turns out any MusicPlayer/Player info label combined with ".offset(N)" is unsafe on this Kodi build, not just Duration. Song.next() is now disabled entirely (returns None) instead of trying to fix each individual label one crash at a time - prefetching next-song lyrics was a minor head-start optimization, not essential, since lyrics still get fetched reactively the moment the next track actually starts. 1.5.0: fixed a Kodi crash (native SIGSEGV inside CGUIInfoManager::GetMultiInfoLabel, called via xbmc.getInfoLabel from Python) observed shortly after Song.by_offset() queried "MusicPlayer.offset(N).Duration" for the prefetched next-song lookup added in 1.4.0's duration-aware filtering. That exact info label combination (Duration + a non-zero offset) is far less established than plain "MusicPlayer.Duration", so duration is now only fetched for the current song (offset 0) rather than trying to root-cause a native crash inside Kodi itself. 1.4.0: restored manual lyrics sync correction - the old scrolltosync() feature relied on the lyrics list having native focus (self.controlId == 110) to read a manually-navigated line's timestamp, which was dead code ever since focus was disabled in 1.0.0 for the OK-button/OSD fix, so up/down did nothing for out-of-sync (but correct-edit) timed lyrics. Up/down during timed lyrics now directly nudges a saved offset (with an on-screen readout) instead of depending on focus. Also added duration-aware filtering to the lrclib and musixmatchlrc scrapers so a title/artist match to a different edit (radio edit, remix, extended version) with a different length is rejected instead of producing badly out-of-sync lyrics. 1.3.0: fixed plain (untimed) txt lyrics getting stuck showing only the first line forever - a regression from the 1.0.0 OK-button/OSD fix, which disabled focus on the lyrics list so onFocus() (and the up/down scroll handling that depended on it) never fired. Timed LRC lyrics were unaffected since those auto-scroll via a timer regardless of focus. Up/down now moves the txt lyrics selection directly. 1.2.0: fixed a false-positive match in the Music163 scraper - it sometimes only has songwriter/composer credit lines in its lyric DB (e.g. "作词 : ..." / "作曲 : ...") with no actual lyrics, but returned them as if they were valid, blocking the real Genius/musixmatch result from being tried. Now checks the returned lyric actually has content beyond credit lines. 1.1.0: fixed a bug where the lrclib.net scraper could crash with an uncaught TypeError when the API returned an unexpected (non-list) response, which silently aborted the entire remaining lyrics search cascade (musixmatch, genius, supermusic, etc. never got tried). The lrclib scraper is now defensive against bad responses, and both scraper loops in gui.py now catch exceptions per-provider so one broken source can no longer block the rest. 1.0.0: fork of upstream 6.7.1. Fixed OK button being swallowed by lyrics dialog focus; OK now shows OSD and lyrics auto-resume when OSD closes.

extension.summary: Patches Aeon Nox 5 for CU LRC Lyrics + DC Artist Artwork DL compatibility
extension.description: Run this once from Program add-ons (after skin.aeon.nox.5 and, ideally, script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed / service.xderecx.musicfanart are installed). Patches up to 3 of skin.aeon.nox.5's own files: (1) 1080i/script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml - hides the topbar.png control that draws a dark band over lyrics text, and adds the rotating-fanart background control used by DC Artist Artwork DL; (2) 1080i/MusicVisualisation.xml - hides the skin's own static fanart background so it can't cover the rotating one; (3) 1080i/Font.xml - fixes missing Slovak/Czech diacritics in 2 of the 5 lyrics display fonts. Each file gets a one-time backup (.bak) before patching; re-running is a no-op for anything already applied. Restart Kodi afterwards for the changes to take effect. Only tested against Aeon Nox 5 on CoreELEC (Omega) - refuses to touch anything on other skins since the target files won't match.
extension.news: 1.10.0: the translation credit box is now smaller again (height 82 to 62, another 75%) and moved further down to stay directly above the translation panel with the same half-height gap rule (top 647 to 677, gap now 31px instead of 41px). 1.9.0: the translation credit box (group id 141) is now smaller (height 110 to 82, 75%), moved down to sit directly above the translation panel with a gap equal to half its own height (top 580 to 647, so its bottom is now 41px above the panel's top at 770), and its background opacity now matches the translation panel's own (colordiffuse C0000000 to 80000000) instead of being more opaque than it. Also added a dedicated smaller font_translation_source (20 vs 28) to Font.xml for the translation-panel source textbox only, leaving the translated lyric lines' own font unchanged. 1.8.0: moved the translation-panel source textbox up (top 975 to 940) - at height 70 it was overflowing the panel's bottom edge by 5px (panel bottom is 1040). 1.7.0: the translation-panel source strip is now a 2-line textbox (was a single-line label) so a hybrid human+machine result can show its coverage percentage on its own line instead of being truncated. Requires script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed 1.21.0+ to actually populate the second line. 1.6.0: adds a translation-credit overlay (group id 141) to script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml - once the last timed lyric line has passed, if a human translation source was used (never for DeepL/Google/Lingva), shows a "translation by X, support them at Y" message for ~25s in the now-idle lyrics area. Requires script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed 1.16.0+ to actually trigger it. 1.5.0: seek-progress overlay repositioned to the top of the screen and widened to match the translation panel's width/left margin (45,1830 instead of 360,1200), instead of the centered box over the middle of the lyrics text. 1.4.0: adds a seek-progress overlay (group id 140) to script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml - a translucent progress bar plus elapsed/total time and the +/-amount just seeked, shown briefly on left/right during timed or untimed lyrics, using the skin's own osd/texturebg_cache.png + osd/midtexture.png textures and Player.Progress/Player.Time/Player.Duration infolabels so the bar itself needs no per-frame Python updates. Requires script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed 1.11.0+ to actually trigger it. 1.3.0: now patches skin.aeon.nox.5.skinbase too, not just skin.aeon.nox.5 - skinbase is Aeon Nox 5's own pristine copy of itself, used by the skin's built-in "reset to default" feature, and was silently missing all 4 patches (confirmed by direct comparison: none of the 3 patched files matched, and script-cu-lrclyrics-sync.xml did not exist there at all). A skin reset would have reverted every fix in this addon without warning. 1.2.0: adds a 4th file, script-cu-lrclyrics-sync.xml - a dedicated, wide window for the lyrics sync-offset slider (context menu "Sync", or up/down on timed lyrics), instead of reusing the skin's shared DialogSlider.xml (also used for volume/seek/brightness everywhere else in Kodi). Unlike the other 3 patched files, this one is a brand new file this addon introduces rather than an existing file it patches, so it needs no .bak backup. Also adds font_sync to Font.xml for it. 1.1.0: now patches all 3 skin files this repo ships overrides for (script-cu-lrclyrics-main.xml, MusicVisualisation.xml, Font.xml) in one run with a single combined confirmation, instead of only the lyrics topbar file - the other two were previously manual-copy-only (skin-overrides/) and easy to miss, and script.cu.lrclyrics.fixed / service.xderecx.musicfanart now declare this addon as a real <requires> dependency so Kodi installs it alongside them automatically. 1.0.3: added missing icon declaration. 1.0.2: fixed extension point (was the invalid bare "xbmc.python", now "xbmc.python.script" - that bare string is only valid in a requires/import, not as an addon's own type). 1.0.1: fixed repository install (bundled skin file was confusing Kodi's addon-type detection inside the zip). 1.0.0: initial release.

addon.name: CoreELEC: Network watchdog (connman restart on boot)

extension.summary: Restarts connman if no LAN IP shows up within 60s of boot
extension.description: Run this once from Program add-ons. Installs a systemd oneshot service (network-watchdog.service) and its script to /storage/.config/ on this CoreELEC box. At every boot it waits up to 60s for a 192.168.x.x LAN IP (ignoring WireGuard/OpenVPN/PPP tunnel interfaces); if none appears, it restarts connman and checks again. Fixes boots where the network never comes up on its own. Idempotent - running it again just confirms the files are already installed and the service enabled. Not a Kodi/skin fix - a system-level boot reliability fix, same delivery mechanism (a one-time Program add-on) as the other patches in this repo.
extension.news: 1.0.0: initial release - packages the network-watchdog systemd service confirmed working on x96max+.

extension.summary: Real fanart backgrounds for the currently playing music artist
extension.description: Lightweight replacement for Artist Slideshow. Looks up TheAudioDB / fanart.tv / Deezer for the currently playing artist and exposes the result via Window(Visualisation).Property(ArtistSlideshow.Image), compatible with the existing Aeon Nox 5 MusicVisualisation.xml patch. Runs as a proper Kodi background service (started once at Kodi startup) instead of a re-invoked script, avoiding the stuck/zombie "already running" issue. Only tested on Aeon Nox 5 - the service itself works on any skin, but nothing will be visible without that skin's MusicVisualisation.xml patch (see script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix) or equivalent skin wiring.
extension.news: 1.7.1: description clarifies this addon is only tested against Aeon Nox 5. 1.7.0: now declares script.xderecx.aeonnox5lyricsfix as a real add-on dependency (this addon does nothing visible without that skin patch applied), so Kodi installs it automatically alongside this one instead of it being an easy-to-miss separate manual step - it still needs to be run once from Program add-ons to actually patch the skin. 1.6.0: now auto-switches to the visualisation screen (rotating fanart + lyrics) whenever audio playback starts, instead of leaving whichever library/browsing screen was open beforehand - so starting an album from anywhere in Kodi jumps straight to the now-playing view. 1.5.0: fixed fanart appearing permanently frozen on one image whenever CU LRC Lyrics is showing (i.e. most of the time). Root cause: the visible screen during playback is usually the lyrics dialog window, not the plain visualisation window - Kodi only continues to actively redraw the topmost open window, so the visualisation window's own image control (bound to our rotating property) stopped getting refreshed the moment the lyrics dialog opened, freezing on whichever image was showing at that instant, even though the underlying property kept updating correctly every 12s. Also tried routing updates through Kodi's native library fanart field via AudioLibrary.SetArtistDetails, but Player.Art(fanart) turned out to be a one-time snapshot per track (not live), so that alone doesn't fix mid-song rotation either - kept it anyway since a real per-track native fanart is still a nice side benefit and survives library rescans reasonably (re-asserted every rotation cycle). The actual fix (paired with a companion aeon-nox-5 skin patch, see skin-overrides/) adds a background image control directly inside the lyrics dialog's own XML, bound to the same rotating property, so it refreshes as part of that window's own active render loop instead of relying on the frozen window underneath. 1.4.0: fixed the artist fanart rotation permanently freezing on one image - Rotator.run() had no exception handling, so any single unhandled error (e.g. a stale path from a race with a fresh download) silently killed the rotation thread for the rest of the Kodi session. Now logs and keeps looping instead. 1.3.0: fixed addon settings showing values with no labels at all (blank rows) - the settings.xml used inline text for each setting's label instead of a numbered string ID resolved via strings.po, which this Kodi build silently fails to render for addon settings. Added a proper resources/language/resource.language.en_gb/strings.po and pointed each setting's label at its string ID, matching how the other working addons in this repo do it. 1.2.0: fixed a real bug - xbmc.Player().getPlayingFile() returns a musicdb://songs/... virtual URL (not a real path) when a track is played from the Kodi music library view, which silently broke library-folder saving (it always fell back to the private cache instead). Now resolves the real on-disk path via Player.GetItem's "file" property first. 1.1.0: added Deezer as a third image source (no API key needed) - mainly helps Slovak/Czech and other regional artists that TheAudioDB/fanart.tv don't have at all. Added an on-screen "searching for fanart..." notification on first fetch for a new artist, so it's clear something is happening during the initial download delay. 1.0.0: initial release.
